title: What the Year 2000 Would Be Like
subtitle: 未来展望 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）
meta: 主题语境：未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）　|　核心词汇：science　|　正文 302 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 science 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 our ① science teacher asked the class to write down what the year 2000 would be like, and eleven of us wrote about flying cars. He kept the papers for thirty-one years and handed them back in 2005. On his own sheet he had written one line: that ② science would not be the difficulty.

He was right about that and wrong about nearly everything else, as ③ science usually is when it is asked about the future. He thought there would be colonies on the moon by 1990 and fusion by 1995, and he wrote both down with the confidence of a man who has never once been wrong about the past. He said the science of 1974 was more confident than the science of 2005, and that this is the wrong way round.

What he taught us in the ④ science block, eleven benches and one sink, was not the facts but the habit of writing things down and being wrong in public. He said a ⑤ science is not a body of knowledge but a habit of being wrong in public, and that the science he loved was the one that changed its mind.

My own children think ⑥ science is a subject you choose at fourteen, and I have never corrected them. There is ⑦ science fiction on the shelf by my desk, given to me by him in 1976, and in the margin he has written, in pencil, that the future is not a ⑧ science and cannot be, because it has no experiments and no second attempt.

He died in 2003, two years before he could hand the papers back, and his daughter did it for him. The ⑨ sciences have moved on, of course, and the ⑩ science of predicting the future has not; it is still eleven people writing about flying cars.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 科学（总称，不可数）
B. n.[pl.] 理科；自然科学各学科
C. n. 一门科学；学科（a science）
D. n. 学问；技艺；原理（the science of ...）
E. 固定搭配：science fiction 科幻小说
F. adj./n. 理科的；科学课的（a science teacher / the science block）
G. n. 科学界；科学（science says / science usually is ...）
H. n. 科学精神；科学方法

items.q: our science teacher asked the class
that science would not be the difficulty
as science usually is when it is asked about the future
He said a science is not a body of knowledge
My own children think science is a subject
There is science fiction on the shelf
the future is not a science
the science of predicting the future

answers.why: a science teacher 意为“理科教师”，1974 年他让全班写下 2000 年会是什么样。
science 意为“科学”，他写道：科学不会是难事。
science 此处指“科学（界）”，说科学在被问到未来时通常就是这个样子。
the science block 意为“理科楼、科学楼”，里面有十一张长凳和一个水槽。
a science 此处指“科学这门学问／科学精神”，他说科学不是知识堆积，而是公开承认错误的习惯。
science 意为“科学”，我自己的孩子以为科学是十四岁时选的一门课。
science fiction 意为“科幻小说”，书架上那本是 1976 年他送我的。
a science 意为“一门科学、学科”，他在页边写道：未来不是一门科学，也不可能是。
the sciences 复数意为“各门理科／自然科学学科”，它们当然都在进步。
the science of doing 意为“做某事的学问／原理”，预测未来的学问一点也没进步。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，我们的理科老师让全班写下 2000 年会是什么样子。（science teacher）
他在自己的纸上写道：科学不会是难事。（science）
科学在被问到未来时通常就是这个样子。（science）
他在理科楼里教我们的不是事实，而是把事情写下来的习惯。（science block）
我自己的孩子以为科学是十四岁时选的一门课。（science）
预测未来的学问一点也没有进步。（the science of）

He wrote on his own sheet that science would not be the difficulty.
